Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, positive nitrites, presence of bacteria, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli in culture, consistent with a urinary tract infection. Mild hematuria is present. Low urine specific gravity may indicate dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy.
